resources.string: Allows enabled Maxa tools to observe screen content, insert text, perform gestures and capture screenshots. System permission and installation confirmations remain human-only. Enable only if you trust all software running in Termux.

All software installed or run in Termux shares one Android user ID. It can read the host identity and pairing credentials and can call every capability you enable here. Run only software you trust in Termux.
Copy the command, paste it into a plain Termux shell and press Enter. It verifies the script and agent, installs offline, links to this app and starts the agent. Run it again to update or repair.
This APK has no agent payload (placeholder build); installation is disabled.
Copied as sensitive content. Paste it into a plain Termux shell only.
The current link key stops working immediately. Run the new install command in Termux to link again.
The Termux agent can no longer use this app until you link again.
Each capability is off by default. Turning one on opens the matching system page; grant the permission there yourself.
Read elements, tap, swipe, type and take screenshots. Requires the accessibility service. Keeps the screen on during remote control until 10 minutes after the last action.
You confirm every recording on this device.
Requires “Install unknown apps”. You confirm every install and uninstall.
Reading briefly brings this app to the foreground.
Used by maxa-device android usage. Requires “Usage access”.
If the accessibility switch is greyed out, open App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings first (sideloaded apps on Android 13+).
Enable the modules in Termux, request pairing from Maxa, then compare the verification code and approve it in Termux.

All optional and your choice: keep Termux awake, exempt Termux from battery optimization, and start the agent with Termux:Boot or termux-services (the installer registers a supervised service when termux-services is installed). Android may still stop it; some Android 12+ devices also need child-process limits lifted in developer options. On the tested HyperOS tablet, setting Termux to No restrictions was enough when no plugins shared its UID. If Termux:API is installed and the host freezes, keep Termux visible in a floating window or split screen, or manually add com.termux.api to MILLET_NO_RESTRICT_APP via ADB without removing existing entries.
Allow this app to run in the background
This app may run in the background
This app is battery-optimized; Android may freeze its local service in the background

Accessibility is on in system settings but the service is not connected. Another UiAutomation client (for example Windows ADB automation of this phone) suppresses accessibility services, or autostart is blocked. Stop that client, allow autostart, then turn the service off and on.
Stops the local service and invalidates the link.

Each switch takes effect immediately. Enable only what trusted Termux programs need. Android permissions and on-device confirmations are separate. Turn off remote UI control and stop screen recording before reviewing a request or granting Android permissions.
No enabled capability is waiting for a system permission.
